ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-contrast (white) patches appearing on the distal portion of the right lobe and peripheral margins of the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch on the distal-ventral tip of the right lobe; small, high-intensity punctate clusters along the far lateral leading edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex; approximately 45-degree angle of separation between the proximal lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, high-frequency irregular serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; moderate-amplitude irregular peaks along the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a convex sweep towards a tapered tip; left lobe exhibits an irregular, ragged trailing edge trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white circular clusters visible on the outer margin/tip of the left lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular marginal tissue loss or extreme serration on the left lobe trailing edge compared to the right; high-contrast white scarring on the distal right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Strong morphological asymmetry between the trailing edge profiles of the left and right lobes.
